job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, test, and deploy AI-powered solutions using Python and Generative AI tools.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
Develop data pipelines to extract insights from large datasets and integrate them into machine learning models.
Troubleshoot issues related to AI model performance, data quality, and system reliability.

Job Requirements :

3-5 years of experience in IT Services & Consulting industry as an Engineer or similar role.
Strong proficiency in Python programming language with expertise in Generative AI frameworks like GANs (Generative Adversarial Networks).
Experience working on projects involving natural language processing, computer vision, or other AI-related fields.
